correctness.rationale: The source's product moment-generating function identifies the third-level law, up to translation and reflection, with a three-term iid Bernoulli weighted sum. Sorting the positive integer weights as \(\{1,u,v\}\), all collisions among the eight subset sums are exhausted by \(u=1\), \(u=v\), or \(v=u+1\). These give five exact entropy formulas. Each second derivative is strictly negative using only \(h''=-1/[p(1-p)]\), \(p(1-p)\le1/4\), \(h\le\log2\), and the sign of \((2p-1)\log((1-p)/p)\). No experimental enumeration is used as proof.
